subject: Fix VLA warning in io_threads (#3518)
reason: The change only replaces a `const int BATCH_SIZE = 32` local with `#define BATCH_SIZE 32` in io_threads.c so the `batch_jobs[BATCH_SIZE]` array is no longer a compiler-flagged VLA. The array size and all runtime behavior are identical; this is a warning-silencing refactor with no observable behavior change, so no scenario is needed.
